title: H. H. ARTERBERRY
text:
H. H. ARTERBERRY.

At present, H. H. Arterberry has the oldest dry goods establishment in town. He has lived near here all his life and before going in business for himself, clerked for Russell, Bradford & Co. He has made many friends and established a fine trade by his straightforward business methods. He handles first class goods and sells them reasonably, always allowing his customers all the privileges and time on payments that is consistent with business principles and never crowds them until he is forced to do so. His customers are scattered over all the country intervening between neighboring towns and even across the river Red.

His clerks are courteous and accommodating, which has much to do with holding his trade.
notes: Business profile/advertisement from early Savoy publication. References Russell, Bradford & Co. as a prior employer. Customers described as extending across the Red River.
